LLVM/Clang redistribution notice for Sparrow Helper
===================================================

Bundled components
------------------

- LLVM/Clang version: 20.1.0
- clang.exe
- clang-format.exe
- Clang 20 built-in resource headers (`lib/clang/20/include`)
- Upstream project: https://llvm.org/
- Release source: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/tree/llvmorg-20.1.0
- License: Apache License 2.0 with LLVM Exceptions
- SPDX identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception

The complete LLVM license is provided in LLVM-LICENSE.txt. If the bundled LLVM
package is changed or upgraded, its version, hashes, license files, and any
additional third-party notices must be reviewed and updated before distribution.

Clang resource header notices
-----------------------------

The resource headers are copied unchanged from the official LLVM installation,
including their in-file copyright and license notices.  Most headers use
Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception.  The LLVM 20.1.0 Windows package also contains
headers with embedded permissive MIT-style terms, including arm_fp16.h,
arm_neon.h, selected AVX/keylocker intrinsic headers, and cuda_wrappers headers.
Those in-file terms remain applicable and are not replaced by this summary.

Generated or small wrapper headers without an individual SPDX marker are kept
with the unmodified official resource-header set and the complete upstream LLVM
license above.  A public binary release must retain this directory unchanged and
review the exact upstream package's complete third-party notices; this project
notice alone is not a substitute for that upstream audit.
